Project Lyra – Exploring Interstellar Objects
Project Lyra develops concepts for reaching interstellar objects such as 1I / 'Oumuamua and 2I / Borisov with a spacecraft, based on near-term technologies. But what is an interstellar object?
Laser sail spacecraft arriving at 'Oumuamua, the interstellar asteroid (Credit: Maciej Rebisz)
What is 1I/'Oumuamua and what is an Interstellar Object?
On October 19th 2017, the University of Hawaii’s Pan-STARRS 1 telescope on Haleakala discovered a fast-moving object near the Earth, initially named A/2017 U1. It is now designated as 1I/’Oumuamua. This object was found to be not bound to the solar system. It has a velocity at infinity of ~26 km/s and an incoming radiant (direction of motion) near the solar apex in the constellation Lyra. Due to the non-observation of a tail in the proximity of the Sun, the object does not seem to be a comet but an asteroid. More recent observations from the Palomar Observatory indicate that the object is reddish, similar to Kuiper belt objects. This is a sign of space weathering.
Discovery of the Second Interstellar Object, 2I/Borisov and Spacecraft Missions
When will such an object visit us again? End of 2019, a second interstellar object, 2I/Borisov was discovered, which is a comet. As 1I/‘Oumuamua and 2I/Borisov are the nearest macroscopic samples of interstellar material, the scientific returns from sampling the object are hard to overstate. Detailed study of interstellar materials at interstellar distances are likely decades away, even if Breakthrough Initiatives’ Project Starshot, for example, is vigorously pursued. Hence, an interesting question is if there is a way to exploit this unique opportunity by sending a spacecraft to 1I/’Oumuamua to make observations at close range.
Project Lyra and the Initiative for Interstellar Studies
Logo for Project Lyra
To answer these questions, the Initiative for Interstellar Studies, i4is, announced Project Lyra on the 30
th
October 2017. The goal of the project is to assess the feasibility of a mission to 1I/’Oumuamua, 2I/Borisov and other potential interstellar objects, using current and near-term technology and to propose mission concepts for achieving a fly-by or rendezvous. The challenge is formidable: 1I/’Oumuamua has a hyperbolic excess velocity of 26 km/s, which translates to a velocity of 5.5 AU/year. It will be beyond Saturn’s orbit within two years. This is much faster than any object humanity has ever launched into space. Compare this to Voyager 1, the fastest object humanity has ever built, which has a hyperbolic excess velocity of 16.6 km/s. As 1I/’Oumuamua is already on its way of leaving our solar system, any spacecraft launched in the future needs to chase it. The challenge to reach the object could stretch the current technological envelope of space exploration.

After days of intense work, we (i.e. Andreas M. Hein, Nikolaos Perakis, Kelvin F. Long, Adam Crowl, Marshall Eubanks, Robert G. Kennedy III & Richard Osborne) have published some preliminary results on the 8
th

here

'Optimum Interplanetary Trajectory Software' (OITS
)
. His discoveries using OITS were then incorporated into the paper and a revised version of the paper
"Project Lyra: Sending a spacecraft to 1I/’Oumuamua (former A/2017 U1), the interstellar asteroid"
was eventually accepted by the journal Acta Astronautica and was published on the 7th of January 2019 (find

and

for Acta version).
In the paper, we demonstrate that missions to 'Oumuamua are feasible with current and near-term technologies (Falcon Heavy or Space Launch System launcher, solid rocket motors, and Parker Solar probe heat shield), with an optimal launch date in 2021. However, this launch date would be too soon for developing a dedicated spacecraft, something that usually takes 5 to 10 years for an interplanetary mission.

44655741.article_summary:
Project Lyra旨在利用现有和近期技术，设计飞船任务以探访星际物体，如1I/'Oumuamua和2I/Borisov。1I/'Oumuamua是2017年由夏威夷Pan-STARRS 1望远镜发现的星际小行星，其速度高达26 km/s，正在离开太阳系。与之相比，人类最快的飞行器Voyager 1仅有16.6 km/s。由于'Oumuamua移动迅速，任何未来发射的飞船都需追赶它，这带来了巨大挑战。

Project Lyra团队研究表明，利用现有技术（如Falcon Heavy、Space Launch System和Parker Solar Probe的热盾）可在2021年发射飞船探访'Oumuamua，但时间过于紧迫。因此，团队进一步研究了2024年后的发射机会，为飞船开发留出更多时间。这些研究结果已在多个期刊发表。

data.article_summary: 文章主要讨论了斯瓦尔巴特群岛冬季变暖达到融化临界点的问题。斯瓦尔巴特位于气候危机的前线，以全球平均速度的六到七倍快速升温。特别是冬季变暖速度最快，气温上升导致积雪大范围融化。2025年2月，斯瓦尔巴特经历了异常高温和降雨，引发广泛的融雪和积水。这种冬季解冻事件的频率显著增加，预示着北极正发生根本性变化。冬季变暖不仅影响冰层形成，还影响微生物活动、营养物质释放以及永久冻土的融化。随着气候变化加剧，冬季变暖事件的频率和强度将继续增加，对北极生态系统和社会产生深远影响。研究团队在 Ny-Ålesund 开展的冬季研究也因变暖和降雨受到干扰，凸显了在日益变化的条件下维持科学研究的挑战。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：对斯瓦尔巴群岛（Svalbard）的旅游体验、气候变化影响及交通问题的讨论

不同观点：
• **netsharc**：分享了2025年2月底亲身访问斯瓦尔巴群岛的经历。他提到当地正从煤炭产业向旅游业转型，并描述了气候变化对当地气温的影响，比如遇到的反常"热浪"（0℃左右），让他感到失望。此外，他讲述了一次航班因技术问题无法起飞，导致乘客被送回奥斯陆的突发事件，并提到一位乘客因此错过飞往韩国的航班。netsharc对当地的极端气候和旅游基础设施的局限性有直接的体会。

• **jonstewart**：分享了夏季游览斯瓦尔巴群岛的经历，特别是乘船游览Spitsbergen并接近海冰。他提到由于海冰破裂，他们无法使用小艇登陆。他对当地的自然景观表示赞赏，但也指出由于气候变化，冰川状态不再适合传统的旅游活动。他将Bråsvellbreen冰川与《权力的游戏》中的"长城"作比较，突显其宏伟和广袤。

• **Hikikomori**：持一种消极和冷漠的态度，认为即使气候变化等问题存在，人们也无法采取有效行动，表现出对全球气候变化和环境问题的无力感或漠不关心。他的评论更像是对气候变化讨论的哲学性或态度性回应，而非具体的经历或事实支持。

补充讨论：
• **气候变化的影响**：netsharc和jonstewart都提到了气候变化对斯瓦尔巴群岛的影响。netsharc提到异常升高的气温，jonstewart则提到海冰的破碎化，二者都暗示了气候变化对当地自然环境和旅游体验的改变。

• **旅游业的挑战**：netsharc的评论中提到了当地旅游业面临的交通和基础设施问题，比如航班问题和国际边境检查带来的麻烦，这表明斯瓦尔巴作为旅游目的地的运营仍然存在一定风险和不确定性。

• **争议焦点**：虽然没有直接的对立观点，但Hikikomori的态度与netsharc和jonstewart的实际体验形成对比。前者对气候变化和人类行动持悲观态度，而后两者则基于个人经历讨论了气候变化的具体影响。这种态度差异可以看作是关于如何应对和看待气候变化问题的潜在争议。

Svalbard winter warming is reaching melting point
Download PDF
Download PDF
Subjects
Biogeochemistry
Cryospheric science
The Arctic is at the forefront of global climate change and is encountering unprecedented winter warming. In February 2025, exceptionally high air temperatures and rainfall over Svalbard triggered widespread snowmelt and pooling of meltwater. Increasingly frequent winter thaw events are reshaping Arctic landscapes, signaling a dramatic shift towards a new Arctic.
Accelerated winter warming and wetting
Svalbard is at the front line of the climate crisis, warming at six to seven times the global average rate
1
. Human-caused global warming is particularly amplified in the Arctic, causing the climate in the Arctic to warm more quickly than the rest of the Earth
2
. The winter period is experiencing the highest rates of warming
3
with winter temperatures over Svalbard rising at nearly twice the annual average
4
,
5
,
6
. Meanwhile, centennial trends for annual precipitation in west Svalbard show increases of 3–4 % per decade, of which a greater proportion is falling as rain
7
. As such, over the past 40 years, rain-on-snow events have significantly increased, and rain is projected to become the dominant form of precipitation in the Arctic by the end of this century
7
.
This year, Arctic winter air temperatures were among the warmest ever recorded
8
. In Ny-Ålesund, the world’s northernmost permanent settlement, situated in north-west Svalbard and approximately 1,200 km from the North Pole, the air temperature average for February 2025 was -3.3 °C — considerably higher than the 1961-2001 average for this time of year of -15 °C (Fig.
1a
)
9
, and reached a maximum of 4.7 °C. Air temperatures higher than 0 °C were recorded in Ny-Ålesund on 14 of the 28 days of February 2025 (Fig.
1b
). Such sustained warmth, coupled with prolonged rainfall, triggered widespread melting of snow and ice. When winter warming crosses the 0 °C threshold, it marks more than just a warm anomaly — it signals a fundamental shift in Arctic winter dynamics. Episodic thawing events during winter can have significant and lasting environmental consequences, including influencing ice layer formation, triggering microbial activation, altering nutrient discharge, and affecting permafrost thaw and ground ice development. The episodic warming event of February 2025 was not an isolated occurrence: winter warming events in Svalbard have been a recurring phenomenon in recent decades as a consequence of anthropogenic climate change
3
. As climate change continues to take hold, the frequency and magnitude of winter warming episodes will increase, and so will their effects on Arctic systems and societies.
Fig. 1: Warming over Svalbard during February 2025.
a
Surface air temperature anomaly for February 2025 over the Arctic region relative to the February average for the period 1991–2020. Data source: ERA5
8
, obtained from the Copernicus Climate Change Service (C3S), implemented by the European Center for Medium-Range Weather Forecasts (ECMWF)
24
.
b
Daily air temperatures for February 2025 from Ny-Ålesund observation station, Svalbard, elevation 8 m, established in July 1974. The solid black line is the daily average. The black boxes represent the minimum and maximum temperatures recorded. The horizontal dashed black line represents the average air temperatures for Longyearbyen, Svalbard, for the month of February between 1959–2001, estimated from the instrumental Svalbard Airport series
9
. Background stripes are colored according to the daily maximum temperature.
Full size image
Our teams are working in Ny-Ålesund to study glacial and terrestrial microbial communities and their role in carbon and other elemental cycles during the dark, frozen, winter period, for which data remains scarce
10
. Our winter-time field campaigns in Svalbard are conducted under the expectation of sub-zero temperatures and extensive snow cover — conditions that have historically been typical in Svalbard during winter, but in recent years are increasingly threatened by climate change. However, in February 2025, we encountered air temperatures persistently above 0 °C, as well as rainfall, exceptionally low snow cover, and pooling meltwater covering the tundra. Wintertime warming and rain turned Ny-Ålesund and the surrounding landscape into a melting ice rink, disrupting planned sampling efforts, forcing adaptations in methodologies, provoking new scientific questions, and raising concerns about the long-term feasibility of our winter research practices and logistics under increasingly variable conditions and rising temperatures.
The new Arctic
Ny-Ålesund has been a hub for scientific research in the high Arctic for the last five decades
7
. Researchers worldwide come to the remote Arctic outpost to study and monitor terrestrial and marine ecosystems, glaciers, and atmospheric processes, collecting vital information about the functioning of Arctic systems and

data.title: It's a DE9, not a DB9 (but we know what you mean)
data.author: jgrahamc
data.article_summary: 本文讨论了D-sub连接器的命名误用，特别是常见的9针串行端口连接器。虽然广泛被称为"DB9"，但技术上正确的命名应为"DE9"。"D"代表D型金属屏蔽，"E"表示壳体大小容纳9针，而"DB"实际上是指25针的连接器。这一错误源于IBM PC/AT引入9针串口时，人们习惯性地将"DB25"的命名方式套用到新连接器上，导致"DB9"这一不准确的称呼广泛传播。SparkFun在推出新的DE9连接器分线板时，选择使用正确的技术命名以推广准确性。文章强调了技术准确性的重要性，并解释了命名背后的原因。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：技术术语的准确使用与沟通的有效性之间的平衡

不同观点：
• dlcarrier：认为在文档中应使用标准机构的术语（如8P8C），但在日常交流中可以使用更常见的术语（如RJ45），以确保沟通的清晰性。
• mark-r：对将DB-25称为旧并行端口连接器提出异议，指出其更早用于RS-232串行端口，并行端口通常使用更大的Centronics连接器。
• zettabomb：赞赏D-sub连接器的持久性，指出其在军事和现代空间硬件中的应用，尽管个人不优先选择使用。
• Cyan488：幽默地建议Sparkfun应纠正“传统电流”的长期混淆。
• 9rx：质疑“DB9”术语不准确的说法，认为即使没有实际制造，DB壳中也可以容纳9针连接器。
• alnwlsn：指出技术术语的混用常见，尤其是在连接器常用于特定用途时，如“复合视频”和其他视频相关术语。
• alnwlsn：进一步提到“Amphenol连接器”、“Cannon连接器”或“Molex连接器”类似于说“福特汽车”。
• brudgers：认为未误用D-sub术语，因为大家在玩一种不同的“语言游戏”，沟通有效即可。
• dec0dedab0de：个人习惯称串行端口，因记不住DB9，但希望记住这些细节以备将来使用。
• djaychela：认为在交流中使用更通俗的术语（如“kettle lead”）比坚持技术准确性更有效。
• shermantanktop：技术上的咬文嚼字虽有趣，但语言的首要目的是沟通，最正确的语言是能最佳传达信息的语言。
• 1970-01-01：以VGA、键盘鼠标端口为例，幽默地指出无法联系到旧打印端口（DB-25）以发表意见。
• gchadwick：好奇为何D-sub壳大小和针脚编号分开定义，质疑是否有计划在同一壳中使用更少针脚。
• Findecanor：提到存在非标准的D-subminiature连接器，如Amiga使用的23针连接器。
• andix：认为继续使用DB9术语大家都能理解，不会引起误解也不浪费时间讨论术语。
• cwillu：认为DB更容易发音，且大家都明白其含义，坚持使用DB9术语，认为标准应考虑人类习惯。

补充讨论：
• 技术准确性与沟通效率之间的矛盾是主要争议焦点，部分人支持使用标准术语以保证准确性，另一部分人则认为应使用通俗术语以确保沟通顺畅。

• 讨论中还涉及到其他技术术语的混用现象，反映了技术语言在演变中的多样性和复杂性。

It's a DE9, Not a DB9. (But We Know What You Mean)
by
Christo-boots with the-pher
July 21, 2025
Engineering
History
You have been misusing the D-sub connector terminology, and we're guilty of it, too.
You’ve seen them everywhere, especially on older computer equipment: the classic 9-pin serial connector. You probably know it as a DB9. It’s an iconic connector for makers, engineers, and anyone who's ever used an RS232 serial device. Here's a little secret, though: calling it a DB9 is technically wrong. The correct name is actually DE9.
With the release of our new DE9 Connector Breakouts, we wanted to address a common misconception and explain why we named our boards as we did.
SparkFun DE9 Breakout - Male
BOB-29195
Easily connect with the SparkFun DE9 Male Breakout, a compact board that brings all nine DE9 pins to a convenient 0.1in. spac…
$3.95
SparkFun DE9 Breakout - Female
BOB-29196
Easily connect with the SparkFun DE9 Female Breakout, a compact board that brings all nine DE9 pins to a convenient 0.1in. sp…
$3.95
In the Interest of Fairness:
We are omitting the "-" in "DE-9" and "DB-25." We have found that using a "-" is optional in writing this information.
What's in a Name? The D-Subminiature Standard
The connector in question belongs to a family known as D-subminiature, or D-sub for short. To put it simply, the "D" in the name comes from the D-shaped metal shield surrounding the pins, which ensures the plug can only be inserted one way!
The full part number for these connectors follows a specific pattern. The first letter is always D for the D-shape. The second letter, however, is where the confusion starts. It doesn't stand for a feature; it specifies the size of the connector's shell. The number that follows indicates the number of pins in that shell.
Here’s a quick breakdown of the standard D-sub shell sizes:
DA
: 15-pin shell
DB
: 25-pin shell (This is the big one you'd see on old parallel printer ports)
DC
: 37-pin shell
DD
: 50-pin shell
DE
: 9-pin shell (Today's topic)
The correct technical designation for a D-sub connector with nine pins is DE9. Although "DB9" is a widely used term, it is a misnomer based on the D-sub naming convention, where the second letter signifies the shell size. The "E" in DE9 denotes the specific shell size that houses nine pins while the letter "B" refers to a larger shell designed for 25 pins, as seen in a correctly named DB25 connector. To be blunt, the term "DB9" is plainly inaccurate because it pairs the 25-pin "B" shell with a 9-pin count, a physical contradiction. Despite this, "DB9" became the de facto standard name and is commonly understood to refer to the 9-pin serial connector.
So, Why Do We All Call It DB9?
The mix-up is a classic case of mistaken identity that just stuck. The original IBM PC used a DB25 connector for its serial and parallel ports. When the smaller 9-pin serial port was introduced on the IBM PC/AT, it quickly became the new standard for serial ports.
Most people, already familiar with the term "DB25," simply swapped the number of pins and started calling the new connector a DB9. The incorrect name spread like wildfire and became the de facto standard term, despite being technically inaccurate. It's a prime example of typical usage winning out over technical accuracy.
Our Naming Philosophy: Correctness and Clarity
With the launch of our new
SparkFun Male DE9 Breakout
and
SparkFun Female DE9 Breakout
, we made a conscious decision to use the technically correct name. This blog post is our explanation for why.
At SparkFun, we are engineers, makers, and educators at heart. We believe in technical accuracy and in sharing our knowledge with the community. While we know that a vast majority of people search for "DB9," we felt it was essential to stick to the correct DE9 designation for our products.
It’s our small way of doing our part to correct a decades-old mix-up. We want our product names to be accurate and serve as a learning opportunity for anyone curious about the "why." So when you see the "DE9" on our new breakouts, you'll know that the name is as intentional as the engineering that went into the board itself.
So, while the world might continue to refer to it as DB9, we'll call it for what it is: a DE9. Happy hacking!

Late in the
evening on July 23, developers with
games
tagged as NSFW on
Itch.io
, a digital marketplace, began to notice something strange. Their work—whether it was a game about navigating disordered eating as a teenager, or about dick pics—no longer appeared in search results.
“No notification or anything,” says former NYU Game Center educator and developer Robert Yang, whose work explores gay history and culture. “Just found out via Bluesky.”
Itch.io is deindexing, or removing from its search index, any and all adult NSFW games, regardless of why they’ve been tagged that way. Games are marked this way for a variety of reasons, whether it’s due to sexual themes, discussions of mental health, or stories that otherwise involve triggering topics.
On the Itch.io site,
founder Leaf Corcoran said the “sudden and disruptive” move is the direct result of an ongoing campaign by Collective Shout, an organization critics have alleged is “anti-porn.” The group has recently targeted payment processors for Itch and Steam, urging the banking services to stop doing business with those platforms because of the content they host, a tactic known as
financial censorship
. The move comes a week after
Steam removed
from its own storefront hundreds of adult titles allegedly containing instances of abuse, rape, or incest, which
Collective Shout has claimed
was “a result of our campaign.”
(On its site, Collective Shout refers to itself as a “grassroots campaigns movement” that protests the objectification and sexualization of women and girls.)
Corcoran did not respond to a request for comment. Valve, which owns the Steam distribution platform, did not respond to multiple requests for comment. In a statement given to
PC Gamer
, the company said it was “recently notified that certain games on Steam may violate the rules and standards set forth by our payment processors and their related card networks and banks,” and that those games were pulled as a result.
Payment processors hold a great deal of power over the companies that use them. When companies like Mastercard or Visa pull support, it impacts that platform’s ability to receive payments. Conservative groups sometimes use these financial institutions to put pressure on companies to change their services. Insiders in the adult entertainment industry, which has seen similar campaigns lobbied against platforms like PornHub and OnlyFans, call these tactics a form of censorship that can hurt, not help, vulnerable creators. Itch’s mass removals, which are being enforced on a widespread scale with apparently little consideration of context, have already affected some developers who are queer, female, or people of color, even for award-winning projects.
On Itch’s website, Corcoran called this “a critical moment” for the site. “Our ability to process payments is critical for every creator on our platform,” Corcoran wrote. “To ensure that we can continue to operate and provide a marketplace for all developers, we must prioritize our relationship with our payment partners and take immediate steps towards compliance.”
A Punch in the Wallet
In March, developer Zerat Games published an Adults Only game to Steam and Itch.io called
No Mercy
. Self-described as a game about incest and “male domination,” the game included “unavoidable non-consensual sex.” It garnered
international outrage
, including from the UK’s technology secretary and Parliament member Peter Kyle. Following the backlash, the game was
pulled from UK, Australian, and Canadian storefronts
, while Zerat removed it from others.
At the same time, Collective Shout—the nonprofit had previously worked with
anti-porn group
The National Center on Sexual Exploitation (NCOSE) to rally against platforms like OnlyFans and Reddit that host adult content—began campaigning to have
No Mercy
removed from storefronts. Collective Shout campaigns manager Caitlin Roper tells WIRED that the organization contacted Valve on multiple occasions about
No Mercy
but did not receive a response.
Roper claims that Collective Shout found almost 500 games tagged with rape or incest, some of which “included extreme sexual torture and abuse of women.” Roper did not answer questions about the methodology behind the group’s investigation into which games should be deemed problematic. “Given Steam had not responded at any point, we wrote an open letter to payment processors asking them to stop processing payments on gaming platforms which host rape-, incest-, and child-sexual-abuse-themed games,” Roper says.

on July 11

data.title: Why MIT switched from Scheme to Python (2009)
data.author: borski
data.article_summary: MIT switched from Scheme to Python for its introductory programming course (6.001) because modern programming has shifted from a focus on deep understanding and simple composable parts (like resistors) to dealing with complex, often poorly documented software libraries and unpredictable systems (like robots). In the past, programming required careful thought and understanding of the entire system, while today's programming involves more trial-and-error and working with incomprehensible code. The new course, centered around robotics, emphasizes building robust systems in a more practical context. Python was chosen mainly because it had the necessary libraries for robotics, making it a more pragmatic choice over Scheme. While this shift may produce more practical programmers, some argue it sacrifices the deep foundational knowledge that schemes like Scheme provide.
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：MIT从Scheme切换到Python作为计算机科学入门语言的背景、原因及不同观点

不同观点：
• **Keith Winstein**（亲历者）：  
  - 认为不能简单地说MIT从Scheme切换到Python，实际上是整个EECS课程从四个深度课程转变为两个广度调查课程。  
  - Scheme（通过6.001课程）强调的是计算机科学的基本概念，而不是语言本身，Python在6.01中主要用于简化编程任务，并不是让学生深入学习Python。  
  - 课程改革的背景是2000年代中期，EECS enrollment下降，尤其是特定人群对该学科的兴趣减退，课程设计需要更具吸引力。  

• **MontyCarloHall**：  
  - 认为这是CS系从计算机科学教学转向计算机工程教学的一部分，反映了大学教育日益职业化的趋势。  
  - Scheme适合纯计算机科学教学，而Python更适合应用型计算机工程，因其在实际工程中更常用。  

• **varenc**（老课程受益者）：  
  - 对旧的Scheme课程有深厚感情，认为Scheme让他对计算机科学有了深刻的理解和热爱。  
  - 担心新课程无法带来同样的启示。  

• **ted_dunning**：  
  - 强调Python的生态系统是其优势，Python拥有大量库，可以简化如机器人接口的实现。  
  - 但也指出了依赖半文档化库的挑战和风险。  

• **KenSF**：  
  - 认为Scheme的纯粹和简洁性是其优点，Scheme能帮助学生理解抽象和不变性等核心编程原则。  
  - 对Scheme的消失感到遗憾。  

• **mrexroad**（Scheme的启示）：  
  - 回忆Scheme教学中函数式编程的启示，认为这是他学习生涯中的关键时刻。

44685119.article_content:
Costanza asked Sussman why MIT had switched away from Scheme for their introductory programming course, 6.001. This was a gem. He said that the reason that happened was because engineering in 1980 was not what it was in the mid-90s or in 2000. In 1980, good programmers spent a lot of time thinking, and then produced spare code that they thought should work. Code ran close to the metal, even Scheme — it was understandable all the way down. Like a resistor, where you could read the bands and know the power rating and the tolerance and the resistance and V=IR and that’s all there was to know. 6.001 had been conceived to teach engineers how to take small parts that they understood entirely and use simple techniques to compose them into larger things that do what you want.
But programming now isn’t so much like that, said Sussman. Nowadays you muck around with incomprehensible or nonexistent man pages for software you don’t know who wrote. You have to do basic science on your libraries to see how they work, trying out different inputs and seeing how the code reacts. This is a fundamentally different job, and it needed a different course.
So the good thing about the new 6.001 was that it was robot-centered — you had to program a little robot to move around. And robots are not like resistors, behaving according to ideal functions. Wheels slip, the environment changes, etc — you have to build in robustness to the system, in a different way than the one SICP discusses.
And why Python, then? Well, said Sussman, it probably just had a library already implemented for the robotics interface, that was all.
(via
wingolog
)
You might also like some of these
107 thoughts on “Why MIT switched from Scheme to Python”
So the reason, basically, is that software today is a train wreck, and you might as well embrace helplessness and random tinkering from the start? Horrifying.
Reply
Unbelievable.
Reply
Pingback:
Why I Find Software Depressing
I don’t know about 6.001, but if is a introductory course for non software engineers / CSers, I totally agree: practical reasons…
Reply
This is a shame.  I’ve been reading their introductory programming course, because I felt that using C or something higher (mostly VB in my case) is quick, but does not teach you how to be what I call a ‘real programmer’, and it doesn’t.
Reading their Scheme-based course is an eye-opener.
I see the reasoning behind their move to Python, which may have more immediate application and even make more sense to someone who does not have a background in CS, but really, it will only further the financial interests of MIT.  I can’t help but feel someone Higher Up (duh duh duuuhhhhh) has pushed this on them. MIT will now churn out countless applications programmers.  Half decent ones I am sure, but not the kind of full-on nerds that make the *very best* programmers.
There seems to be such a divorce between systems and hard mathematical programmers on one hand, and applications programmers on the other.  But regardless, programmers who have been raised on really, really geeky stuff are the best ones. EOF. 😉
I started with Pascal and BASIC, moved on to 80×86 assembly and *then* went to C and C++. I spent my school years breaking the school systems and finding out how they worked.  These days I would say that I am a very bad programmer (though lack of practice), but I am still a million times better than someone who has been taught using only Java or Python, because I have a basic but functional knowledge of PCs and a feel for the workings of hardware and limitations of systems.
Going back to Scheme and Python:
When I started reading their course using Scheme, and I saw the way it worked, it was like I had come to the top of a mountainous pass and suddenly saw the blue-green vista of endless, verdant fields stretching away before me.  That is a feeling I have not had in the last 10 years with regards programming and it is a crying shame that forthcoming MIT first-years will not have the same degree of understanding.
It’s not about doing things, it’s about being able to do them.  Anyone who knows how can write a brilliant programme, but if you are not apprised of The Way, then you will *have* to settle for mediocrity.
Reply
Python is better at teaching introductory and deeper knowledge.  Scheme is a must know but Python is practical, but attracts many smart programmers because of the ability to prototype quickly and understand the problem at hand not the mountain of ramp up that scheme can do.  I agree with this and look at it this way, it could have been worse, it could have been Java.
Python is by far my favorite language I can use to prototype and developer real world applications from desktop, web, system admin, services, game development and many other things.
Plus CS grads will be familiar still with lambdas, tuples, lists as they are used in CS, dictionaries and they will start out with a clean dictated style.  Python I believe will continue to win out over Java def
44685119.article_summary: MIT switched from Scheme to Python for its introductory programming course (6.001) because modern programming has shifted from a focus on deep understanding and simple composable parts (like resistors) to dealing with complex, often poorly documented software libraries and unpredictable systems (like robots). In the past, programming required careful thought and understanding of the entire system, while today's programming involves more trial-and-error and working with incomprehensible code. The new course, centered around robotics, emphasizes building robust systems in a more practical context. Python was chosen mainly because it had the necessary libraries for robotics, making it a more pragmatic choice over Scheme. While this shift may produce more practical programmers, some argue it sacrifices the deep foundational knowledge that schemes like Scheme provide.

data.title: Allianz Life confirms data breach impacts majority of 1.4M customers
data.author: gpi
data.article_summary: Allianz Life证实其140万客户中的大多数受到数据泄露影响。2025年7月16日，攻击者通过社会工程技术入侵了第三方云CRM系统，获取了客户的个人身份信息。尽管公司立即采取措施遏制问题并通知了FBI，但调查仍在进行中。泄露信息涉及客户、财务专业人士及部分员工，不过尚未发现公司其他系统被入侵。此次攻击疑似由勒索组织ShinyHunters发起，该组织曾参与多次高调网络攻击。Allianz Life正联系受影响个体并提供帮助。

44696136.article_content:
Allianz Life confirms data breach impacts majority of 1.4 million customers
By
Lawrence Abrams
July 26, 2025
02:00 PM
0
Insurance company Allianz Life has confirmed that the personal information for the "majority" of its 1.4 million customers was exposed in a data breach that occurred earlier this month.
"On July 16, 2025, a malicious threat actor gained access to a third-party, cloud-based CRM system used by Allianz Life Insurance Company of North America (Allianz Life)," an Allianz Life spokesperson told BleepingComputer.
"The threat actor was able to obtain personally identifiable data related to the majority of Allianz Life's customers, financial professionals, and select Allianz Life employees, using a social engineering technique."
"We took immediate action to contain and mitigate the issue and notified the FBI. Based on our investigation to-date, there is no evidence the Allianz Life network or other company systems were accessed, including our policy administration system."
"Our investigation is ongoing and we began the process of reaching out to individuals impacted with dedicated resources to assist them. This incident is related only to Allianz Life, which currently has 1.4 million customers."
Allianz Life is a US-based provider of annuities and life insurance for over 1.4 million Americans. The company is owned by Allianz SE, a global financial services group headquartered in Germany, serving more than 128 million customers.
The company first revealed the breach in a mandatory filing with
Maine's Attorney General's Office
on Saturday, issuing a placeholder notification alerting of the breach.
"The consumer notice will be provided once Allianz has identified the affected individuals," reads the placeholder notification.
While Allianz Life declined to answer questions about the threat actor and whether they were being extorted, BleepingComputer has learned that the attack is believed to have been conducted by the ShinyHunters extortion group.
ShinyHunters is a group of threat actors who are linked to multiple high-profile data breaches and attacks, including those against
PowerSchool
and the
SnowFlake attacks
, which impacted
Santander
,
Ticketmaster
,
AT&T
,
Advance Auto Parts
,
Neiman Marcus
, and
Cylance
.
While multiple ShinyHunters members have
been arrested
over the
past few years
, including a
recent arrest in France
, the hacking group continues to conduct attacks.
Last month, Mandiant warned that ShinyHunters had begun to
target Salesforce CRM customers
in social engineering attacks.
During these attacks, the hackers impersonate IT support personnel, requesting the targeted employee accept a connection to Salesforce Data Loader, a client application that allows users to import, export, update, or delete data within Salesforce environments.
Once the connection is accepted, the threat actors use Salesforce Data Loader to exfiltrate data from Salesforce, which is then used to extort the company.
BleepingComputer asked Allianz Life if the CRM is Salesforce, but the spokesperson declined to comment.

data.title: Wirth's Law
data.author: tosh
data.article_summary: Wirth's law，由计算机科学家Niklaus Wirth提出，指出软件变慢的速度比硬件变快的速度更快。这一观点在1995年他的文章《A Plea for Lean Software》中被详细讨论。Wirth认为，软件的膨胀和用户对功能需求的增加导致了这一现象，并呼吁开发更"精简"的软件。Oberon系统便是这一理念的实践，旨在用更少的硬件资源实现高效功能。该定律也被称为Page's law，并有其他变种如Gates's law和Andy and Bill's law，均描述了类似现象。这些定律反映了软件复杂性增加与硬件进步之间的矛盾。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：现代应用程序开发中的性能、复杂性及工具演变

不同观点：
• ozgrakkurt 认为，现代应用程序开发者与30年前不同，现代的工具（如V8引擎、VLC的AV1解码器、NVIDIA的CUDA库）应该与过去的技术一样好。他暗示，尽管开发环境和工具发生了变化，但最终性能和质量应该保持高水平。

• erwan577 持批判态度，指出Wirth’s Law（即软件变慢的速度比硬件变快的速度更快）依然有效。他认为，虽然硬件性能提升使得开发者能够使用更多层次的抽象和复杂工具，但这导致了系统难以理解和维护。他强调，现代系统过度依赖多层间接、微服务、配置文件等，使得开发者难以全面掌握系统的工作原理，失去了对整体的可控性和理解力。他提到了像Red、MIR和Metamath这样的项目，认为这些项目展示了可理解和简洁系统的价值。

• mike-the-mikado 则认为，运行时优化在现代计算机上已经变得不那么重要，因为当前的硬件性能使得许多应用的运行时表现“可接受”。他暗示，开发者可能因为现代硬件的能力而不再优先考虑优化问题。

补充讨论：
• erwan577 进一步讨论了AI时代的到来，工具能自动生成代码，虽然这提高了生产力，但也削弱了开发者对系统整体的理解，开发者逐渐依赖机器生成代码，而不再深入思考系统的工作原理。

• 争议的焦点在于，现代应用程序开发中是否应该继续关注性能优化，以及复杂的工具和多层抽象是否对开发有利。Erwan577认为复杂性和抽象导致系统不可控，而ozgrakkurt和mike-the-mikado则似乎更接受现代工具和硬件带来的变化，认为这些变化总体上是有益的。

• Erw an577 还提到了开发者对系统整体的“可理解性”的丧失问题，这是其他评论者没有深入讨论的一个重要层面。

44695995.article_content:
From Wikipedia, the free encyclopedia
Adage on computer performance
Wirth's law
is an
adage
on
computer performance
which states that
software
is getting slower more rapidly than
hardware
is becoming faster.
The adage is named after
Niklaus Wirth
, a
computer scientist
who discussed it in his 1995 article "A Plea for Lean Software".
[
1
]
[
2
]
History
[
edit
]
Wirth attributed the saying to
Martin Reiser
, who in the preface to his book on the
Oberon System
wrote: "The hope is that the progress in hardware will cure all software ills. However, a critical observer may observe that software manages to outgrow hardware in size and sluggishness."
[
3
]
Other observers had noted this for some time before; indeed, the trend was becoming obvious as early as 1987.
[
4
]
He states two contributing factors to the acceptance of ever-growing software as: "rapidly growing hardware performance" and "customers' ignorance of features that are essential versus nice-to-have".
[
1
]
Enhanced user convenience and functionality supposedly justify the increased size of software, but Wirth argues that people are increasingly misinterpreting complexity as sophistication, that "these details are cute but not essential, and they have a hidden cost".
[
1
]
As a result, he calls for the creation of "leaner" software and pioneered the development of
Oberon
, a software system developed between 1986 and 1989 based on nothing but hardware. Its primary goal was to show that software can be developed with a fraction of the memory capacity and processor power usually required, without sacrificing flexibility, functionality, or user convenience.
[
1
]
Other names
[
edit
]
The law was restated in 2009 and attributed to
Google
co-founder
Larry Page
. It has been referred to as
Page's law
.
[
5
]
The first use of that name is attributed to fellow Google co-founder
Sergey Brin
at the 2009
Google I/O
Conference.
[
6
]
Other common forms use the names of the leading
hardware
and software companies of the 1990s,
Intel
and
Microsoft
, or their CEOs,
Andy Grove
and
Bill Gates
, for example "What Intel giveth, Microsoft taketh away"
[
7
]
and
Andy and Bill's law
: "What Andy giveth, Bill taketh away".
[
8
]
Gates's law
("The speed of software halves every 18 months"
[
9
]
) is an anonymously coined variant on Wirth's law, its name referencing Bill Gates,
[
9
]
co-founder of Microsoft. It is an observation that the speed of
commercial software
generally slows by 50% every 18 months, thereby negating all the benefits of

feature creep
,
code cruft
, developer laziness, lack of funding, forced updates, forced porting (to a newer
OS
or to support a new technology) or a management turnover whose design philosophy does not coincide with the previous manager.

10
]
May's law
, named after
David May
, is a variant stating: "Software efficiency halves every 18 months, compensating Moore's law".

44695995.article_summary: Wirth's law，由计算机科学家Niklaus Wirth提出，指出软件变慢的速度比硬件变快的速度更快。这一观点在1995年他的文章《A Plea for Lean Software》中被详细讨论。Wirth认为，软件的膨胀和用户对功能需求的增加导致了这一现象，并呼吁开发更"精简"的软件。Oberon系统便是这一理念的实践，旨在用更少的硬件资源实现高效功能。该定律也被称为Page's law，并有其他变种如Gates's law和Andy and Bill's law，均描述了类似现象。这些定律反映了软件复杂性增加与硬件进步之间的矛盾。
44695995.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：现代应用程序开发中的性能、复杂性及工具演变

不同观点：
• ozgrakkurt 认为，现代应用程序开发者与30年前不同，现代的工具（如V8引擎、VLC的AV1解码器、NVIDIA的CUDA库）应该与过去的技术一样好。他暗示，尽管开发环境和工具发生了变化，但最终性能和质量应该保持高水平。

• erwan577 持批判态度，指出Wirth’s Law（即软件变慢的速度比硬件变快的速度更快）依然有效。他认为，虽然硬件性能提升使得开发者能够使用更多层次的抽象和复杂工具，但这导致了系统难以理解和维护。他强调，现代系统过度依赖多层间接、微服务、配置文件等，使得开发者难以全面掌握系统的工作原理，失去了对整体的可控性和理解力。他提到了像Red、MIR和Metamath这样的项目，认为这些项目展示了可理解和简洁系统的价值。

• mike-the-mikado 则认为，运行时优化在现代计算机上已经变得不那么重要，因为当前的硬件性能使得许多应用的运行时表现“可接受”。他暗示，开发者可能因为现代硬件的能力而不再优先考虑优化问题。

补充讨论：
• erwan577 进一步讨论了AI时代的到来，工具能自动生成代码，虽然这提高了生产力，但也削弱了开发者对系统整体的理解，开发者逐渐依赖机器生成代码，而不再深入思考系统的工作原理。

• 争议的焦点在于，现代应用程序开发中是否应该继续关注性能优化，以及复杂的工具和多层抽象是否对开发有利。Erwan577认为复杂性和抽象导致系统不可控，而ozgrakkurt和mike-the-mikado则似乎更接受现代工具和硬件带来的变化，认为这些变化总体上是有益的。

• Erw an577 还提到了开发者对系统整体的“可理解性”的丧失问题，这是其他评论者没有深入讨论的一个重要层面。

data.title: Electrify completes majority investment in Veritasium
data.author: jsphweid
data.article_summary: Electrify宣布对拥有超过1300万YouTube订阅者的科学教育频道Veritasium进行重大投资。自2010年创立以来，Veritasium已成为科学教育和娱乐领域的领先数字视频内容制作者。此次投资将帮助Veritasium扩大高质量内容制作，并探索新的商业机会，包括其科学教育产品Snatoms的扩展。Veritasium创始人Derek Muller将继续在内容创作中发挥关键作用，同时成为Electrify Video Partners的股东。Electrify联合创始人Ian Shepherd表示，投资旨在帮助优秀创作者实现潜力，并与Veritasium团队合作推动下一阶段增长。Veritasium以其多样化内容和揭露公众科学误解的视频闻名，目前视频总数超过400个，2022年观看次数超过4亿。

data.title: Great Oxidation Event
data.author: Bluestein
data.article_summary:
这篇文章简要介绍了地球大气中氧气的历史，特别是**古元古代**氧气增加事件（**Great Oxidation Event**，GOE）。GOE发生在大约24.5亿到20.6亿年前，标志着地球大气和浅海中自由氧气开始积累。这一事件主要由**蓝藻**通过光合作用产生氧气引发，导致地球从无氧环境转变为含氧环境。

在GOE之前，地球大气中几乎没有氧气，海洋也大多是缺氧的。随着氧气的产生，它最初被海洋和海底岩石吸收。之后，氧气开始从海洋中逸出，但被陆地表面吸收，总体氧气水平没有显著变化。直到新元古代，氧气才开始在大气中积累。

GOE对早期生命产生了重大影响，许多**厌氧生物**因氧气的毒性而灭绝。这一事件可能导致了**真核生物**和**多细胞生命**的出现。文章还提到早期地球大气主要由氮气（N₂）和二氧化碳（CO₂）组成，氧气含量极低。早期地球在太阳光较弱的情况下仍保持温暖，这可能是由于二氧化碳或甲烷等温室气体的存在。

From Wikipedia, the free encyclopedia
Paleoproterozoic surge in atmospheric oxygen
For the second (Neoproterozoic) surge in atmospheric oxygen, see
Neoproterozoic oxygenation event
.
Timescale
O
2
build-up in the
Earth's atmosphere
. Red and green lines represent the range of the estimates while time is measured in billions of years ago (Ga).
[
1
]
Stage 1 (3.85–2.45 Ga): Practically no O
2
in the atmosphere. The oceans were also largely anoxic—with the possible exception of O
2
in the shallow oceans.
Stage 2 (2.45–1.85 Ga): O
2
produced, rising to values of 0.02 and 0.04 atm, but absorbed in oceans and seabed rock. (Great Oxidation Event)
Stage 3 (1.85–0.85 Ga): O
2
starts to
gas out
of the oceans, but is absorbed by land surfaces. No significant change in oxygen level.
Stages 4 and 5 (0.85 Ga – present): Other O
2
reservoirs filled; gas accumulates in atmosphere.
[
2
]
Stage 4 is known as the
neoproterozoic oxygenation event
.
The
Great Oxidation Event
(
GOE
) or
Great Oxygenation Event
, also called the
Oxygen Catastrophe
,
Oxygen Revolution
,
Oxygen Crisis
or
Oxygen Holocaust
,
[
3
]
was a time interval during the
Earth
's
Paleoproterozoic
era
when the
Earth's atmosphere
and
shallow seas
first experienced a rise in the concentration of
free
oxygen
.
[
4
]
This began approximately 2.460–2.426 billion years ago
(Ga)
during the
Siderian
period and ended approximately 2.060 Ga ago during the
Rhyacian
.
[
5
]
Geological,
isotopic
and chemical evidence suggests that biologically produced molecular oxygen (
dioxygen
or O
2
) started to accumulate in the
Archean
prebiotic atmosphere
due to
microbial
photosynthesis
, and eventually changed it from a weakly
reducing atmosphere
practically devoid of oxygen into an
oxidizing
one containing abundant free oxygen,
[
6
]
with oxygen levels being as high as 10% of modern atmospheric level by the end of the GOE.
[
7
]
The appearance of highly reactive free oxygen, which can oxidize
organic compounds
(especially
genetic materials
) and thus is toxic to the then-mostly
anaerobic
biosphere
, may have caused the
extinction
/
extirpation
of many early organisms on Earth—mostly
archaeal
colonies
that used
retinal
to use green-spectrum
light energy
and power a form of
anoxygenic photosynthesis
(see
Purple Earth hypothesis
). Although the event is inferred to have constituted a
mass extinction
,
[
8
]
due in part to the great difficulty in surveying microscopic organisms' abundances, and in part to the extreme age of fossil remains from that time, the Great Oxidation Event is typically not counted among conventional lists of "
great extinctions
", which are implicitly limited to the
Phanerozoic
eon. In any case,
isotope geochemistry
data from
sulfate minerals
have been interpreted to indicate a decrease in the size of the
biosphere
of >80% associated with changes in
nutrient
supplies at the end of the GOE.
[
9
]
The GOE is inferred to have been caused by
cyanobacteria
, which evolved
chlorophyll
-based photosynthesis that releases dioxygen as a
byproduct
of
water
photolysis
. The continually produced oxygen eventually depleted all the surface reducing capacity from
ferrous iron
,
sulfur
,
hydrogen sulfide
and
atmospheric methane
over nearly a billion years. The oxidative environmental change, compounded by
a global glaciation
, devastated the
microbial mats
around the Earth's surface. The subsequent
adaptation
of surviving archaea via
symbiogenesis
with
aerobic
proteobacteria
(which went
endosymbiont
and became
mitochondria
) may have led to the rise of
eukaryotic
organisms and the subsequent
evolution
of
multicellular
life-forms.

data.title: Asciinema: Record and share your terminal sessions
data.author: phendrenad2
data.article_summary: asciinema是一款免费开源的工具，用于录制和分享终端会话。它采用轻量级的文本方式，避免了屏幕录制应用和模糊视频的问题。使用方法简单，只需在终端输入`asciinema rec demo.cast`开始录制，结束时按`ctrl+d`或输入`exit`。录制内容可以直接暂停并复制粘贴，因为它们是纯文本。此外，asciinema播放器可以轻松嵌入博客、项目文档或演示文稿中。网站上还展示了多个使用asciinema录制的示例会话，如Worldle-CLI和ChatDBG for lldb等。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：ASCII录屏工具asciinema的使用体验与功能探讨

不同观点：
• **展示与分享用途**：stevengoodwin和kragen认为asciinema是一个很好的工具，可以用来展示终端操作和分享项目，如展示经典的ASCII游戏或Emacs命令。他们强调了asciinema在沟通想法和演示项目方面的实用性，并提供了相关录制的链接。

data.title: Women dating safety app 'Tea' breached, users' IDs posted to 4chan
data.author: gloxkiqcza
data.article_summary: 一款广受欢迎的女性约会安全应用Tea遭遇数据泄露，用户个人信息和自拍照被曝光。4chan用户声称在一个未加保护的Google Firebase数据库中发现了这些数据，并将其发布到网上。Tea证实了此次泄露，称涉及部分两年前的直接消息，但应用目前拥有超过160万用户。该应用旨在为女性提供安全交流的平台，要求用户上传自拍以验证身份。泄露事件包括用户的驾驶证和面部照片，目前漏洞细节已在4chan上广泛传播。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：Tea App的数据泄露事件及其相关问题

不同观点：
• **对数据泄露的强烈谴责**：
  - bravetraveler和gaiagraphia指出Tea App将用户的身份证和自拍等个人信息存储在一个公开的存储桶中，导致用户信息泄露。他们认为这种行为非常不负责任，甚至可能违法。
  - pavel_lishin质疑为什么Tea App要在验证用户身份后继续存储身份证图片。
  - anonzzzies批评现代程序员缺乏基本的安全意识，认为这种疏忽应负刑事责任。

• **对Tea App合法性和伦理性的质疑**：
  - batmaniam将Tea App与失败的Peeple应用进行比较，认为Tea App也是一个潜在的法律炸弹，可能会引发诽谤和偏见问题。
  - ok123456主张禁止非金融服务公司要求用户提供政府ID，认为这是导致身份盗窃风险增加的原因。
  - loeg认为Tea App本质上是一个八卦应用，"安全"只是幌子。

• **技术解决方案和政策建议**：
  - tonymet建议通过App Store审查和安全审计来防止类似事件，例如要求开发者与Apple共享敏感记录并进行审核。
  - kashnote强调科技公司创始人需要具备技术背景，以便更好地处理安全问题。
  - robotnikman认为这一事件为正在实施身份证验证政策的国家和地区提供了一个教训。

• **对数据可靠性和应用用途的质疑**：
  - nis0s指出Tea App中的用户数据不可靠，LLMs可以伪造用户活动，甚至冒充他人。
  - throw838384担心这种应用会被用于背景调查、人肉搜索和网络欺凌，希望能找到避免这些问题的办法。

补充讨论：
• **对隐私和道德的深层担忧**：
  - 1970-01-01认为媒体报道需要更细致，不应将责任归咎于黑客，而应首先责备Tea App开发者。
  - 8f2ab37a-ed6c批评那些支持此类应用存在的人，认为这是对隐私的侵犯，并担心人们可能永远不会从中吸取教训。

争议焦点：
• Tea App的数据泄露事件暴露了科技公司在处理用户数据时的安全漏洞和伦理问题。争议的核心在于如何防止类似事件再次发生，以及此类应用是否应该存在。

“DRIVERS LICENSES AND FACE PICS! GET THE FUCK IN HERE BEFORE THEY SHUT IT DOWN!” the thread read before being deleted.
Image: Tea's website.
Users from 4chan claim to have discovered an exposed database hosted on Google’s mobile app development platform, Firebase, belonging to the newly popular women’s dating safety app Tea. Users say they are rifling through peoples’ personal data and selfies uploaded to the app, and then posting that data online, according to screenshots, 4chan posts, and code reviewed by 404 Media. In a statement to 404 Media, Tea confirmed the breach also impacted some direct messages but said that the data is from two years ago.
Tea, which claims to have more than 1.6 million users, reached the top of the App Store charts this week and has tens of thousands of reviews there. The app aims to provide a space for women to exchange information about men in order to stay safe, and verifies that new users are women by asking them to upload a selfie.
“Yes, if you sent Tea App your face and drivers license, they doxxed you publicly! No authentication, no nothing. It's a public bucket,” a post on 4chan providing details of the vulnerability reads. “DRIVERS LICENSES AND FACE PICS! GET THE FUCK IN HERE BEFORE THEY SHUT IT DOWN!”

data.title: Physicists Create First-Ever Antimatter Qubit, Making the Quantum Even Weirder
data.author: donutloop
data.article_summary: CERN的BASE合作团队在《自然》杂志上发表论文，宣布首次实现反物质量子比特（qubit），这是量子计算机信息的最小单位。他们使用反质子进行实验，观察到其在“上”和“下”自旋状态间稳定 oscillating 达50秒。该实验采用相干量子跃迁光谱学技术，精确测量粒子在磁场中的行为。尽管反物质量子比特目前尚不适用于量子计算，但这一突破为进一步研究物质与反物质的精密实验开辟了新途径，可能对量子计算、原子钟等领域带来工程进展。研究团队计划未来进行更多升级，以提高测量精度。

The antimatter trap at AEgIS, one of the experiments studying antimatter using CERNâs Antiproton Decelerator.
Credit: CERN/Maximilien Brice and Julien Ordan
Readers following our existential physics coverage may remember
a
recent breakthrough
from CERN concerning matterâs evil twin, antimatter. An outstanding mystery in physics is that our universe contains more matter than antimatter, contradicting most theoretical predictions. Scientists, therefore, understandably want to explain why and how this is the case.
CERN announced yet another significant leap for studying antimatterâand this time, the achievement creeps into the realm of quantum computing. In a
Nature
paper published on July 23, CERNâs
Baryon Antibaryon Symmetry Experiment (BASE)
collaboration announced the first-ever demonstration of an antimatter quantum bit, or qubitâthe smallest unit of information for quantum computers.
The qubit in question is an antiproton, a protonâs antimatter counterpart, caught in a curious quantum swingâarcing back and forth between âupâ and âdownâ spin states in perfect rhythm. The oscillation lasted for 50 seconds. The technical prowess that enabled this result represents a significant leap forward in our understanding of antimatter, the researchers claim.
For the experiment, the team applied a technique called coherent quantum transition spectroscopy, which measuresâwith chilling precisionâa particleâs magnetic moment, or its behavior inside magnetic fields. First, the team brought in some antiprotons from
CERNâs antimatter factory
, trapping the particles in an
electromagnetic Penning trap
âa superposition of magnetic fields. Next, they set up a second multi-trap inside the same magnet, extracting individual antiprotons to measure and tweak the particleâs spin states in the process.
Quantum states are fragile and easily disturbed by outside distractions. The wrong push can immediately send them
spiraling down the drain toward decoherence
âat which point the system loses the valuable information physicists hope to find. This fundamental limitation of quantum systems was a major concern for the BASE collaboration, who in 2017 used a similar setup to the new experiment to confirm that
protons and antiprotons had practically identical magnetic moments
.
The team made substantial revisions to its technology, paying special attention to developing the mechanisms needed to suppress and eliminate decoherence. This hard work paid off; the antiproton performed a stable quantum swing for 50 secondsâa motion akin to how qubits exist in superpositions of states, which theoretically could allow them to store exponential loads of information. Additionally, it marked the first time physicists observed this phenomenon in a single free nuclear magnetic moment, whereas previous experiments had only seen it in large groups of particles.
“We immediately opened a bottle of champagneâoneÂ of the best moments of my life!”
Barbara Latacz
, the study’s lead author and CERN physicist, said in an email to Gizmodo. “
It took us five years of very committed work to upgrade an already very sophisticated experiment to a state in which we could observe the coherent spin state spectroscopy. It is very rewarding when you and your colleagues’ effort pays back.”
âThis represents the first antimatter qubit and opens up the prospect of applying the entire set of coherent spectroscopy methods to single matter and antimatter systems in precision experiments,â BASE spokesperson Stefan Ulmer said in a
statement
.Â
Study lead author and physicist Barbara Latacz working in the BASE experiment. Credit: CERN
That said, the team doesnât believe the new results will introduce antimatter qubits to quantum computing, at least not anytime soon.
“It does not make sense to use [the antimatter qubit] at the moment for quantum computers, because, simply speaking, engineering related to production and storage of antimatter is much more difficult than for normal matter,” Latacz explained, adding that since matter and antimatter are known to share fundamental properties, opting for the latter wouldn’t make practical sense. “However, if in the future [we find] that antimatter behaves differently than matter, then it may be interesting to consider this.”
There are additional improvements the team hopes to make, which will happen sometime very soon, Latacz said.
The upgrades to BASEâtermed BASE-STEPâwill greatly improve our capacity to study antiprotons with higher precision and allow us to “improve the measurement of the magnetic moment of the antiproton by at least a factor of 10, and in a longer perspective even a factor of 100,” she said.
The new breakthrough could contribute to engineering advances in quantum computing, atomic clocks, and other areas. But as the researchers emphasize, such technological applications arenât anything we should expect

44695383.article_content:
Your Child’s Brain Grows to 90% of Its Adult Size by Age 5 — Here’s Why That Matters
Mar 11
Written By
Linda Andrews
Did you know that by the time your child turns five, their brain will have reached
90% of its adult size
?
This incredible growth doesn’t just mean their brain is getting bigger—it means it’s forming connections at lightning speed. These early years are when children build the foundation for how they will think, learn, feel, and interact with the world for the rest of their lives.
As a caregiver, that can feel like a lot of pressure. But here’s the beautiful part: you’re already doing so many of the things that support this growth—often without even realizing it.
What Does 90% Brain Growth Really Mean?
It means that the first five years of a child’s life are a powerful window of opportunity. Every hug, every bedtime story, every “why” question, every silly song—they all help build the brain's structure in ways that support lifelong learning and emotional well-being.
Think of your child’s brain like a house. During these early years, you’re laying the foundation and building the framework. Later on, things like school, sports, and social experiences will decorate and shape that house—but what you do now sets the tone for how strong and stable it will be.
So, What Can You Do to Support This Growth?
Here are a few simple, science-backed ways to support early brain development every day:
Talk constantly.
Narrate your day, describe what you see, and ask open-ended questions. Language exposure helps wire the brain for communication and thinking.
Read daily.
Just 10–15 minutes a day of reading builds vocabulary, focus, and imagination. It also builds a deep emotional connection between you and your child.
Play together.
Imaginative play helps children explore emotions, problem-solving, and social interaction.
Sing and rhyme.
Repetition and rhythm help children learn the sounds of language and build memory skills.
Offer comfort and patience.
When you respond with empathy to big feelings, you’re helping your child build emotional regulation and resilience.
What Are Children Learning During This Time?
Between birth and age five, your child is learning:
How to express and understand emotions
How to connect and communicate with others
How to be curious, confident, and creative
How to focus, solve problems, and ask questions
These aren’t just “school skills”—they’re life skills.
The Bottom Line?
You don’t need to be perfect. You just need to be present.
The little things you do each day—reading a book, singing in the car, listening to a story—are shaping your child’s future in powerful ways.
At the Family Resource Centers of Columbia County, we’re here to support you on this journey. Through programs like
Literacy Voyage
, free community playgroups, and family-centered resources, we’re working every day to give caregivers the tools they need to raise confident, curious, and capable kids.
Because when caregivers are supported, children thrive.
Linda Andrews

data.title: WhoFi: Deep Person Re-Identification via Wi-Fi Channel Signal Encoding
data.author: wut42
data.article_summary: 本文介绍了一种名为WhoFi的新方法，利用Wi-Fi信号进行人的再识别（Re-Identification）。传统方法主要依赖视觉数据，但易受光线不足、遮挡和角度不佳等问题影响。WhoFi通过从Wi-Fi的信道状态信息（CSI）中提取生物特征，并使用基于Transformer编码器的深度神经网络（DNN）进行处理。实验结果显示，该方法在NTU-Fi数据集上的表现具有竞争力，证明了其通过Wi-Fi信号识别个体的有效性。

Abstract:
Person Re-Identification is a key and challenging task in video surveillance. While traditional methods rely on visual data, issues like poor lighting, occlusion, and suboptimal angles often hinder performance. To address these challenges, we introduce WhoFi, a novel pipeline that utilizes Wi-Fi signals for person re-identification. Biometric features are extracted from Channel State Information (CSI) and processed through a modular Deep Neural Network (DNN) featuring a Transformer-based encoder. The network is trained using an in-batch negative loss function to learn robust and generalizable biometric signatures. Experiments on the NTU-Fi dataset show that our approach achieves competitive results compared to state-of-the-art methods, confirming its effectiveness in identifying individuals via Wi-Fi signals.

data.title: 3-JSON
data.author: RGBCube
data.article_summary: 文章描述了`tree`命令在2.0.0版本中引入的一个新特性，即如果文件描述符3（stddata）存在，它会自动输出未缩进的JSON格式数据。然而，这一特性引发了问题，因为在Linux环境中，许多脚本可能会随意传递文件描述符，导致意外行为。为此，开发团队在2.0.2版本中修正了此特性，只有当环境变量`STDDATA_FD`被设置为特定描述符时，JSON输出才会生效。文章还展示了使用该特性的示例输出，以及如何在`nushell`中处理这些JSON数据。最终强调，假设用户环境特性往往会导致问题。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：在脚本和程序中引入stddata作为新的标准输出方式及其相关技术选择的争议

不同观点：
• **反对使用环境变量和stddata**：
   - **veltas**：认为stddata类似于全局变量，容易引起冲突，应该使用参数或基于argv[0]的方式，而不是环境变量。
   - **gerikson**：引用"C shell considered harmful"论文，指出sh类shell对文件描述符的使用问题，认为stddata的引入会引发混乱。
   - **Joker_vD**：批评随意使用未声明的文件描述符，强调应用程序应尊重用户设置的环境，并保持可组合性。

• **支持stddata及类似机制**：
   - **smarx007**：认为stddata是向PowerShell等工具看齐的必要尝试，支持结构化输出。
   - **fvwmuser**：指出类似功能在FreeBSD中已经通过libxo实现，不算新概念。

• **关于文件描述符处理的讨论**：
   - **mmastrac**：认为stdX流未被规范为套接字是一个失误，默认的文件句柄继承也是一个重大错误。
   - **EdSchouten**：建议添加新的系统调用或函数，以简化子进程文件描述符的管理。

• **对具体技术选择的质疑**：
   - **krick**：不理解为何不直接添加一个JSON输出选项，并对tree工具的实现表示困惑。
   - **js8**：建议使用CBOR代替JSON，认为JSON不是最优协议。

• **关于潜在危险的警告**：
   - **cryptonector**：认为引入stddata会非常危险，因为很多代码会关闭不需要的文件描述符并打开其他描述符，建议通过新的系统调用来解决此问题。

补充讨论：
• **与主题无关的讨论**：
   - **superdisk**：提到tree工具的开发地，并表示想邀请作者共进午餐。
   - **zbendefy**：提到网页上的版权图标问题，与主要讨论点无关。
   - **NoboruWataya**：询问stddata的来源，表示不熟悉此功能。

争议的焦点：
• 主要集中在stddata作为新的文件描述符是否合适，以及是否会导致现有脚本和程序的兼容性问题。

data.title: High-speed organic light-emitting diodes achieving 4-Gbps communication
data.author: domofutu
data.article_summary: 这篇文章介绍了一种基于dinaphthylperylene的高速有机发光二极管（OLED），其数据传输速率达到了4 Gbps。研究团队通过选择合适的材料和优化器件设计，实现了OLED的超高速传输，在10米长的数据链路上实现了2.9 Gbps的传输速率，误码率为5.54×10^-3，相当于编码后2.7 Gbps的传输速率。在2米长的链路上，传输速率更是达到了4.0 Gbps，误码率为5.54×10^-3，编码后速率为3.7 Gbps。研究表明，OLED的运行稳定性对其高速性能至关重要，未来随着OLED在显示和照明行业稳定性的提升，其在光谱学、通信和传感领域的应用将更加广泛。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：是否应使用OLED而非传统uLED

不同观点：
• [xadhominemx] 认为不应该使用OLED，原因在于传统uLED能够实现更高的性能，并且LED本身的成本在系统总成本中占比较小，因此选择OLED没有必要。
• 潜在反对方（未直接发言，但可推测）：可能认为OLED在其他方面具有优势，例如柔性显示、色彩对比度、广视角等特性，这些优势可能在某些应用场景中比单纯追求性能更重要。

补充讨论：
• [xadhominemx] 强调LED成本在整体系统中占比很小，暗示在系统成本结构中选择更高成本的OLED可能不具备经济效益。
• 未直接提及但可能涉及的争议焦点：OLED的寿命问题、烧屏风险以及能耗效率是否应在选择显示技术时被优先考虑。

Abstract
Organic light-emitting diodes (OLEDs) offer advantages for device-integrated transmitters for optical wireless communication because of their simple fabrication, mechanical flexibility, and integration of multiple color devices on a single substrate. However, they are generally considered to be slow due to low charge mobilities. Here, we show they can be made faster by suitable material selection and device design to achieve record-fast transmission by an OLED. We achieve a data rate of 2.9 Gbps in a 10-m data link at a bit error ratio (BER) of

Visible-light communication (VLC) is rapidly emerging as a compelling technology to supplement radio frequency (RF) communication, with promise for future wireless communications in 6G and beyond. High data rates can be transmitted without interfering with the primary illumination function of an optical source.

data.title: Celebrating 20 Years of MDN
data.author: soheilpro
data.article_summary: 这篇文章庆祝MDN成立20周年。MDN最初是一个社区驱动的wiki，帮助开发者应对快速变化的网络技术，特别强调网络标准。经过20年的发展，MDN现已拥有近14,000页文档、超过33,000篇本地化文章以及近18,000个功能的兼容性数据，成为开发者最信赖的资源。文章回顾了MDN的成长历程，感谢全球社区的贡献，并庆祝其成就。文中还提到浏览器厂商之间互送蛋糕庆祝里程碑的传统，web.dev团队为MDN送来了生日蛋糕。文章最后邀请社区分享他们与MDN的故事，并鼓励更多人参与MDN的协作。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：MDN（Mozilla Developer Network）作为开发者资源的价值和质量

不同观点：
• **MDN的重要性与贡献**：
  - **积极反馈**：多数评论对MDN表示高度赞赏，认为它是学习和参考网络技术的重要资源（[susam], [the_other], [nonhaver], [dwoldrich], [psadri]）。
  - **个人经历**：一些开发者提到MDN帮助他们完成了项目，如游戏开发（[susam]）。
  
• **MDN文档的问题**：
  - **内容过时**：[idoubtit]指出某些教程（如Svelte）已经过时，缺乏更新。
  - **WebExtensions文档质量低**：[idoubtit]提到WebExtensions文档主要针对manifest v2，对v3的支持不足，导致开发者需要转向Chrome的文档。
  
• **文档的可读性与学习难度**：
  - **难以理解**：[miiiiiike]认为MDN文档对不熟悉相关主题的人不够友好，有时不如直接阅读规范或专门书籍（如CSS: The Definitive Guide）。
  - **建议改进**：[miiiiiike]建议MDN能像CSS: The Definitive Guide那样提供更详细的解释，并保持更新。

• **文档组织与结构**：
  - **SVG文档问题**：[socalgal2]指出SVG文档的组织不够直观，缺少对属性和方法的直接描述，用户需要额外点击和查找。
  - **对比HTMLCanvasElement**：[socalgal2]认为HTMLCanvasElement的文档比SVG文档更为清晰，建议将所有相关属性和方法直接列出。

补充讨论：
• **对MDN的捐赠与支持**：
  - **捐赠意愿**：[donatj]询问是否可以直接捐赠MDN而非整个Mozilla组织，显示出用户对MDN的支持和重视。
  
• **MDN与其他资源的变化**：
  - **流量变化**：[v5v3]提到随着Tailwind等新工具和LLM（大型语言模型）的兴起，MDN的流量可能受到影响。
  
• **个人经历与误解**：
  - **早期误解**：[dylan604]分享了自己最初误以为MDN是Microsoft相关的资源而避开使用，后来发现其价值并频繁使用。

争议焦点：
• **MDN文档的质量与更新问题**：部分用户认为MDN的某些文档存在过时和组织不合理的问题，尤其是特定技术（如WebExtensions和SVG）的文档质量和更新速度需要改进。
• **文档的可读性与学习效果**：部分开发者认为MDN文档对初学者不够友好，建议提供更多背景信息和详细解释。

44678512.article_content:
Celebrating 20 years of MDN
Joe Walker
July 23, 2025
3
minute read
This month, we're celebrating a big anniversary: 20 years of MDN.
Twenty years ago, the web was growing into a complex, interactive platform that was getting easier to access, but more challenging to build for.
MDN started as a community-driven wiki, helping developers navigate that rapidly-evolving web with an emphasis on web standards.
As the web platform matured and grew, so did the vast amount of knowledge captured on MDN and the community of people who read and contribute to it.
Today, there's nearly 14,000 pages of documentation, more than 33,000 localized articles, and compatibility data on close to 18,000 features that make MDN the most trusted and comprehensive resource available for web developers.
We've helped people of every skill level and background build a better web for two decades now, driving an open ecosystem that billions of people use to work, learn, shop, socialize, and share their beloved creations.
Time to break out the cake
What would a birthday celebration be without cake?
Well in the web world, cakes have a very special place.
There's a long-standing tradition among browser makers of sending cakes to each other to mark major milestones.
A good cake matters a lot to keep a spirit of collaboration alive between teams who compete at times, but ultimately build towards one open web that everybody can enjoy.
Microsoft sent Mozilla cakes for Firefox 2, 3, and 4, and we also sent them one for IE10:
And what better way to celebrate an MDN birthday, than our own birthday cake from our friends at
web.dev
:
A very big thank you to the web.dev team for the delicious cake, and to all the partners, colleagues, and community members who make MDN what it is today.
It would be hard to mention every single person who has worked on and contributed to MDN, and none of it happens without our global community.
MDN reaches millions of developers each month and over 100,000 contributors have interacted with us through
our GitHub organization
.
From the MDN team, a very big thank you to every single one of you.
Your passion, curiosity, and direct contributions are what keep MDN going.
Here's to 20 more years of empowering developers and building a better web together.
Sharing the love
We'd love to hear about your experiences and memories of MDN over the years; tag us on
X
,
Mastodon
or
Bluesky
if you have stories to share.
There's never been a better time to join us in collaboration on web platform docs.
Getting involved means you have the opportunity to write the next chapter in MDN's story.

data.title: StackOverflow disallows all crawlers in robots.txt file
data.author: yawndex
data.article_summary: 无法获取文章内容
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：StackOverflow更新robots.txt文件，禁止所有爬虫爬取其内容，引发的讨论及其影响。

不同观点：
• [yawndex] 认为StackOverflow更新robots.txt文件、禁止所有爬虫爬取其内容是一个奇怪的决策。他指出，虽然不遵守robots.txt的爬虫仍会继续爬取，但遵守规则的爬虫如Google或Bing的爬虫将无法继续爬取，这可能会严重影响StackOverflow的流量，因为大部分流量来自搜索引擎。

• [VivaTechnics] 认为StackOverflow等网站在大语言模型（LLMs）出现后已经变得过时，禁止爬虫只是其不再创新的一个表现。他认为这是公司停止创新所带来的不可避免的后果。

补充讨论：
• [yawndex] 强调了robots.txt对合法爬虫的限制以及对StackOverflow流量的潜在影响，特别指出搜索引擎流量对StackOverflow的重要性。

• [VivaTechnics] 则从技术发展的宏观角度出发，认为StackOverflow等传统问答网站在LLMs等新技术面前已经失去其原有的优势和必要性，禁止爬虫只是其逐渐过时的一个标志。

争议焦点：
• StackOverflow禁止爬虫是否会导致其流量大幅下降，进而影响其生存。
• 在大语言模型等新技术背景下，传统问答网站如StackOverflow是否已经过时，是否需要创新或转型。

data.title: Inter-Planetary Network Special Interest Group
data.author: OhMeadhbh
data.article_summary: IPNSIG（Interplanetary Networking Special Interest Group）成立于1998年，由Vint Cerf及学术界和NASA/JPL的研究人员创立，现为互联网协会旗下分会，致力于将地球网络扩展至太空。其目标是构建太阳系互联网，连接无人区域，实现“互联网人人可用”。该组织专注于延迟和中断容忍网络（DTN）技术，通过发布架构与治理报告及战略报告，推动相关技术成熟，并与各利益相关方共同创建和推广星际网络愿景，造福人类。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：跨行星网络和Starlink等高延迟网络链接的技术解决方案

不同观点：
• [OhMeadhbh] 提到Vint Cerf在1998年成立的IPN SIG（跨行星联网特别兴趣小组），旨在解决高延迟、高丢失率链路上的IP协议问题。他认为该小组值得关注，但希望有更多关于信息安全的用例。
• [LorenDB] 认为跨行星网络的最可能解决方案是建立远离现有数据中心的大量数据中心和计算资源，并使用类似IPFS的系统进行行星间的数据同步。
• [rippeltippel] 自称是DTNPerf初始版本的作者，提到自己已转向其他软件工程领域，但对DTN技术仍在发展表示欣慰，并指出ESA（欧洲航天局）也在研究该技术。
• [t1234s] 提出量子纠缠是否可以消除网络延迟的问题，暗示对未来技术解决方案的期待。

补充讨论：
• [ieee-e] 以幽默方式评论页面中图形和字体使用，表示对内容严肃性的怀疑，间接提到RFC 1文档。
• [webdevver] 以讽刺方式评论Comcast可能“意外”破坏Starlink卫星链接，暗示对商业竞争的不满。
• [jibal] 分享与Vint Cerf在UCLA的个人经历，表达对Cerf的钦佩。
• [userulluipeste] 对“Solar System”一词的大小写使用进行纠正，强调其应为专有名词，体现对术语准确性的关注。

争议焦点：
- 目前讨论中并无明显激烈争议，但有对技术实现方式的不同设想，如使用现有数据中心扩展（LorenDB）还是专注于DTN技术（rippeltippel）。量子纠缠技术（t1234s）的未来应用也引发了部分讨论。

IPNSIG was founded in 1998 by Vint Cerf and researchers within academia and NASA/JPL. We are now a full Chapter within the Internet Society, known as the Interplanetary Chapter. • [t1234s] 提出量子纠缠是否可以消除网络延迟的问题，暗示对未来技术解决方案的期待。

补充讨论：
• [ieee-e] 以幽默方式评论页面中图形和字体使用，表示对内容严肃性的怀疑，间接提到RFC 1文档。
• [webdevver] 以讽刺方式评论Comcast可能“意外”破坏Starlink卫星链接，暗示对商业竞争的不满。
• [jibal] 分享与Vint Cerf在UCLA的个人经历，表达对Cerf的钦佩。
• [userulluipeste] 对“Solar System”一词的大小写使用进行纠正，强调其应为专有名词，体现对术语准确性的关注。

争议焦点：
- 目前讨论中并无明显激烈争议，但有对技术实现方式的不同设想，如使用现有数据中心扩展（LorenDB）还是专注于DTN技术（rippeltippel）。量子纠缠技术（t1234s）的未来应用也引发了部分讨论。
